android_mechanism: Browser search suggestions materialize all matching history rows eagerly
bug_description: On application startup the main page eagerly queries every per-day history table in the RDB database and materializes all browsing-history rows in memory (Index.aboutToAppear -> RdbUtils.queryAllDate + queryHistoriesByDate for each date), even though history is only consumed when the user opens the browsing-history dialog. Cold-start latency and startup CPU grow linearly with the number of recorded history entries.
fix_summary: History is loaded lazily on first open of the history dialog (PagesDialog.loadHistoryData), and RdbUtils.queryHistoriesByDate now actually awaits the RDB query instead of returning an unfilled array.
trigger_steps: Install and launch the unfixed HAP; browse ~30 distinct pages to seed per-day history tables; exit the app.
hdc shell aa force-stop com.example.nanvision; start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched, disk); hdc shell aa start -a EntryAbility -b com.example.nanvision.
Wait for the main page to finish rendering (logo/search bar visible). Stop hitrace.
Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then rebuild/install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions identically without seeding again.

test_oracle.definition: CPU time of the app process across the case window, from trace.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed_startup_cpu_time_ms > fixed_startup_cpu_time_ms by >= 20% with 30+ seeded history entries; fixed shows zero history-table SELECT queries during startup, unfixed shows N (one per day table).
test_oracle.auxiliary: hilog marker '项目已启动' timestamp delta from process start.

oracle_revision.previous_definition: Sum of CPU time of the app process between process start (first sched wake-up of the ability) and completion of Index.aboutToAppear (last RDB query completion observable in disk/sys traces / hilog marker 项目已启动), measured from the hitrace trace.
oracle_revision.corrected_definition: CPU time of the app process across the case window, from trace.
oracle_revision.reason: The declared metric names CPU time for the startup phase and the collected metric is CPU time for the same case window. The name differed; the quantity did not.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 15 ace app sched disk idle -o /data/local/tmp/browser_eager_startup.chtrace
